## Acronym Information

**Acronym** (3–6 uppercase characters, letters and digits only):
```
WRITE_IT_HERE
```

**Full Name** (what the acronym stands for):
```
Write It Here
```

**Category** (pick exactly one):
- [ ] Networking
- [ ] Security
- [ ] OS
- [ ] Dev
- [ ] Hardware
- [ ] Cloud
- [ ] Database
- [ ] AI
- [ ] Protocol

**Difficulty** (pick exactly one):
- [ ] Base — widely known, used daily by most IT people
- [ ] Intermediate — requires some domain knowledge to understand properly
- [ ] Advanced — typically known only by specialists in the relevant field

## Proposed Description

> Write 1–5 lines. Be technically precise. Do not copy from Wikipedia or vendor docs.
> Explain what it is, how it works, and why it matters.

```
Your description here.
```
